skill.name: reactbits

content.value_statement: React developers need fast ways to find polished animated UI pieces. This skill searches ReactBits and guides component integration into React and Next.js projects.
actual_capabilities: Lists ReactBits component categories and available components.
Searches components by query, category, style, and result limit.
Retrieves full component source by component slug.
Retrieves demo and usage examples for selected components.
Guides integration into React or Next.js component directories.
Identifies dependency needs from ReactBits component metadata.
limitations: Requires access to the ReactBits MCP server tools.
Only covers components available through ReactBits.dev.
Does not independently audit third-party component source code.
Project-specific styling conflicts may need manual adjustment.

use_cases.title: Build a Landing Page
use_cases.description: Find background, text animation, and navigation components that match a requested page style.

use_cases.title: Improve Product UI Motion
use_cases.description: Search for interaction effects, loaders, and cards that can improve a React interface.

use_cases.title: Prototype Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Compare ReactBits demos before choosing components for a fast design prototype.

prompt_templates.title: Browse Components
prompt_templates.prompt: List ReactBits categories and recommend a few beginner-friendly animated components for my React project.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Specific Effect
prompt_templates.prompt: Search ReactBits for a text animation that works well in a Next.js hero section using Tailwind.

prompt_templates.title: Install a Selected Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the source and demo for the selected ReactBits component, then integrate it into my components directory.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Visual System
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend ReactBits components for a product landing page with animated text, interactive cards, and a subtle background.

output_examples.input: Find a hero text animation for a Next.js product page.
output_examples.output: A short list of matching ReactBits text animation components, with style notes and the best fit for the page.

output_examples.input: Add the selected background effect to my React app.
output_examples.output: Component source guidance, dependency notes, file placement, and usage instructions for the target page.

output_examples.input: Help me choose components for a portfolio homepage.
output_examples.output: A grouped recommendation covering text animation, gallery display, navigation, and background options.

best_practices: Choose the Tailwind or CSS style before fetching component source.
Review component dependencies before installing new packages.
Test animation performance on mobile and desktop viewports.
anti_patterns: Do not add many heavy animations to the same viewport.
Do not install dependencies without checking project compatibility.
Do not copy components without adapting accessibility and layout needs.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It uses ReactBits MCP tools to browse, search, and retrieve component source and demos.

faq.question: Does it support Next.js?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is designed for React and Next.js projects.

faq.question: Can it choose Tailwind or CSS versions?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for the preferred style and can request Tailwind or CSS variants.

faq.question: Does it install packages automatically?
faq.answer: It can identify dependencies, but users should review package changes before installation.

faq.question: Does it audit component security?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves component code, but separate review is needed for third-party source changes.

faq.question: What kinds of components are included?
faq.answer: It covers animations, backgrounds, text effects, UI components, buttons, forms, and loaders.
